description: A tuple unified with a list fails when its elements don't convert to the type they unify to
notes: The spec unifies a list and a tuple by preferring the tuple type, which the list converts to here, so the result is the tuple. hashicorp/hcl unifies them to a list of lists of strings, which the tuple converts to on its own (convert([["x"], s], list(list(string))) succeeds), but unifyTuplesAsList in go-cty's cty/convert/unify.go first converts the tuple to a list of the type its own elements unify to, a set of numbers, which fails because "x" isn't a number.
